description.content: API to submit entity's attributes to ASAPP
Add metadata attributes of one agent

response.name:
200 - Success
Submit a single item to the service to be ingested. Record can be traced back to the submitted record by the eventId.
A message sent status will be returned with no error message for successful input checks.

Add multiple agent metadata items; submit items in a batch in one request

response.name:
200 - Success | Partial Success
Submit a batch of items to the service to be ingested. Record can be traced back to the submitted record by the eventId.
If any of the records encounter issue during the ingestion, a message sent status will be returned with an error message for each record.
A 200 success is returned as long as there is one item ingested successfully, i.e., "partial success".

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

400 - Bad request
Submit a batch of items to the service to be ingested. Record can be traced back to the submitted record by the eventId.
If any of the records encounter issue during the ingestion, a message sent status will be returned with an error message for each record.
All items in the batch encountered client input validation failures.
